title: Hecate Strait
html:
Hecate Strait is a North American map added to OpenFront in Update 33.0 by Liam Langford — Strait located in British Columbia; full of fjords.

Nations

The map features 28 named nations, including Old Massett Village, Skidegate, Cape Ball, Cumshewa, Dadens and Haina.

Details

  • Categories: North America
  • Nations: 28
  • Public rotation frequency: 4
